preconditions.description: The number of tree nodes n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of operations m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and ui != vi for ui, vi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation must specify two distinct nodes within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(c >= 0 for c in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: Each count ci must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(c <= n - 1 for c in map(int, stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: Each count ci must not exceed n - 1, as it counts distinct nodes.
